sens_en: to make, to build, to create
origine_fr: En bas, 辶, la marche ; dessus, 告, qui donnait le son mais se lit gào. C'est aller jusqu'à, atteindre. On arrive à un résultat : fabriquer, construire, créer.
origine_en: Below, 辶, walking; on it, 告, which gave the sound but is read gào. It means to go to, to reach. You reach a result: to make, to build, to create.

phrase.pinyin: Zhè zuò qiáo shì qùnián zào de.
phrase.fr: Ce pont a été construit l'an dernier.
phrase.en: This bridge was built last year.
